name: Emerald Horizon AG
summary: Emerald Horizon AG develops solutions for climate change, pollution, and unstable energy networks in Austria. It offers ADES, DUALstore PLUS, CALstore. It also provides SMRX System a complete system that stores and generates high-temperature heat and electricity, combining the DUALstore PLUS and ADES modules. The company develops its technologies for decarbonizing the energy supply under the brand SMRX name. The company was founded in 2019 and is based in Graz, Austria.
